Apart from this, we use four more directions which are as follows - Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, South East . We understand this by the direction indicator. SOME IMPORTANT FACTS TO REMEMBER. If a person stands facing east and ⇒ turns to his left, then he faces north and if he turns to the right, he will face towards south. If a person stands facing west and ⇒ turns to his left, then he faces south and if he turns to the right, he will face north.
